write_up: You show a progression from order picker to outbound shift supervisor. A recruiter can see the work you oversee, but will still want to know how much volume you schedule for and what changed under your supervision.

The night-shift line is the model: it names 35 associates and the three functions they cover. Bring that same detail to the labor scheduling and scanner rollout, without claiming results you can't substantiate.

cards.line: - Supervise a night shift of 35 associates across picking, packing, and loading
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this. It gives a recruiter both the team and the work you're responsible for in one sentence.

cards.cannot_tell: The scheduling work is clear, but the daily order volume isn't. That number would show what you're planning the shift around.

cards.question: What daily order volume do you typically schedule around?

cards.line: - Train new leads on the warehouse management system
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see who you train, but not what you teach them to do in the system.

cards.line: - Helped roll out handheld scanners on the pick floor

cards.question: What did you do to help roll out the handheld scanners?

fit.note: Your experience points toward distribution and warehouse shift supervision. The progression and current team responsibilities are clear; order volume and your part in operational changes would add useful detail.
